additional_info.subject: RE: ID0436260-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002725] - Logs check CRM:02919000132
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena Carusone,
We would like to clarify that the session was initiated via a remote command. In such cases, the session must also be stopped using a remote command, not via RFID.
Attempting to stop a remotely started session using an RFID tag will not be effective, as the system is designed to follow the same method for both starting and stopping the session.
Please feel free to reach out if you have any further questions or need assistance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
